searchLog: 7th straight week of the same failure: the network egress proxy allows only www.anthropic.com and rejects everything else tested today — api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.lever.co, c3.ai, sierra.ai, www.google.com, www.databricks.com, and even en.wikipedia.org (a non-job-board control to confirm this is a proxy-wide default-deny, not a jobs-domain-specific block — it is). Only www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs resolved; it lists Applied AI Architect (multiple teams), Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, and TPM openings, but every individual job link 307-redirects to job-boards.greenhouse.io, which is blocked, so no specific role's application page, deadline, or eligibility could be verified from the real page — same dead end as the prior two runs. Applied AI Architect, Startups was already sent 2026-09-27 and would be a duplicate regardless. WebSearch (which does not go through the blocked proxy) surfaced leads worth a look once fetch access is restored — C3 AI and Netic FDE New Grad postings, and Sierra's 'Software Engineer, Agent (New Grad 2027)' track — but per the verification rule none can be included without loading and confirming the real application page. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output given zero fetchable application pages, not a quality judgment on the target-company list. This is now a persistent infrastructure problem, not a bad-luck day: WebFetch has been unable to reach any job board or company careers domain for at least 3 consecutive logged runs (2026-09-25, 09-26 implied, 09-27, 09-28), degrading every affected morning to the Google News RSS fallback. The proxy allowlist needs a human fix, not a retry.
